visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a white Adidas t-shirt and red shorts stands in a modern hallway with a large black-and-white graphic mural behind him. He makes an exaggeratedly disgusted face, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth as if gagging, while white motion lines radiate from his head to emphasize the reaction. (2) A woman with her hair tied up in a bun, wearing a pink t-shirt, stands in a bright kitchen with white marble countertops and dark grey cabinets. She holds a large, vibrant green bag of Lay's potato chips, which has "Coriander" written in Chinese characters and features images of cilantro leaves. (3) The woman excitedly shows the bag to the camera, pointing at the "Extra Strong" label, while a small dog is briefly visible on the floor in the background. The boy approaches the counter and peers into the bag as the woman starts to tear it open with her hands. (4) The woman reaches into the bag, pulls out a thin potato chip covered in green flakes, and eats it with a smile, looking at the camera. She then hands a chip to the boy, who cautiously takes it with his fingers and puts it in his mouth. (5) The boy's face immediately contorts back into a gagging expression, and he shouts "不好吃!" while a cartoon emoji appears over his face. The woman laughs and continues eating, then hands a chip to an unseen person behind the camera whose hand reaches into the frame.

(6) [Subtitle]: 最近Costco出了這個新的. (7) [Subtitle]: 超級大包的樂事. (8) [Subtitle]: 不是一般的香菜. (9) [Subtitle]: 是濃香菜. (10) [Subtitle]: 而且一個人限購一包. (11) [Subtitle]: 你要多買還不行. (12) [Subtitle]: 我覺得很香耶. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, comical "pop" sound effect followed by the loud, high-arousal sound of a child gagging and making retching noises. A quirky, fast-paced acoustic BGM with a steady electronic beat and light synth melodies begins playing at a moderate volume level. (2) A female voice enters with an energetic, narrative tone, speaking Traditional Chinese at a fast rate with high pitch variability. There is a prominent, high-intensity sound of a large plastic snack bag being rustled and crunched as it is handled and eventually torn open. (3) A male voice with a lower pitch and calm, inquisitive tone is heard asking a question, creating a dialogue with the woman. The BGM continues in the background, maintaining a consistent tempo while the sounds of crisp potato chips being crunched are clearly audible. (4) The child's voice returns, shouting a loud, emotional refusal with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. This is punctuated by a cartoonish "ding" sound effect and a short pause in the narration, though the background music continues to loop steadily. (5) The woman's voice becomes more descriptive, using a professional but friendly broadcasting tone to explain the flavor profile of the chips. The interplay between her speech, the crunching sound effects, and the constant upbeat music creates a dense and highly edited acoustic texture.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Product Intro -> Demonstration -> Reaction -> Detailed Review -> Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review and showcase a polarizing new product—cilantro-flavored Lay's chips—by contrasting a child's extreme dislike with a mother's enthusiastic approval for entertainment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display and opening of the Lay's chip bag, mentioning it was purchased at Costco, and discussing the specific flavor.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A lively family-oriented food review that uses humor and child-parent dynamic to create high engagement for a niche snack flavor.
